sentences.ar: العدد وقف عنده واحد والعملية كلها خلصت في ثانيتين
sentences.en: The counter stopped at one and the whole operation finished in two seconds.

sentences.ar: شايفين إزاي اختيار هيكل البيانات الصح بيوفر وقت مهول؟
sentences.en: See how choosing the right data structure saves enormous time?

sentences.ar: القسم الرابع معنا النهارده بيجمع أهم كروت المقابلات التقنية اللي مفيش غنى عنها واللي بتختبر فهمنا الحقيقي للغة
sentences.en: Today's fourth section gathers the most important technical interview cards, indispensable ones that test our real understanding of the language.

sentences.ar: الكروت دي دسمة جداً ومهمة
sentences.en: These cards are dense and very important.

sentences.ar: في النصوص عندنا دوال أساسية زي lower و split
sentences.en: For strings we have essential functions like lower and split.

sentences.ar: والـf-strings زي f $p colon .2f اللي بتنسق الأرقام بشكل رائع
sentences.en: And f-strings like f"${p:.2f}", which format numbers beautifully.

sentences.ar: الـlist comprehensions سحرية بتخلينا نكتب لوب كاملة في سطر واحد
sentences.en: List comprehensions are magic: they let us write a whole loop in a single line.

sentences.ar: زي إننا نطبق خصم 10% بضرب الأسعار في 0.9 p times 0.9 for p in prices
sentences.en: Like applying a 10% discount by multiplying prices by 0.9: p times 0.9 for p in prices.

sentences.ar: أو نفلتر الأسعار لأكبر من 500 if p is greater than 500
sentences.en: Or filtering prices to those above 500: if p is greater than 500.

sentences.ar: والـslicing أو التقطيع زي colon colon minus 1 اللي بيعكس الـlist فورا
sentences.en: And slicing, like colon colon minus 1, which reverses the list instantly.

sentences.ar: ومهم جدا نفرق بين sorted اللي بترجع list جديدة و.sort اللي بتعدل في الـlist الأصلية مكانها
sentences.en: It's very important to distinguish sorted, which returns a new list, from .sort, which modifies the original list in place.

sentences.ar: نكمل مع باقي الكروت
sentences.en: Let's continue with the rest of the cards.

sentences.ar: الـsets ممتازة في رياضيات المجموعات الاتحاد والتقاطع والفرق
sentences.en: Sets are excellent for set math: union, intersection and difference.

sentences.ar: مثلاً لو طرحنا المستخدمين النشطين active من المشتركين premium هيطلع علينا المستخدمين اللي محتاجين لنشطهم
sentences.en: For example, subtracting the active users from the premium subscribers gives us the users we need to re-engage.

sentences.ar: في الـtuples عشان نعمل tuple من عنصر واحد بس لازم نحط فصلة زي one comma
sentences.en: For tuples, to make a tuple with just one element we must add a comma, like one comma.

sentences.ar: وفي القواميس دايماً نتعوده تستخدمه .get عشان لو المفتاح مش موجود الكود يرجع قيمة افتراضية بدل ما يضرب KeyError ويزعلنا
sentences.en: With dictionaries, always get used to .get, so if the key is missing the code returns a default value instead of throwing a KeyError at us.

sentences.ar: والـCounter بيسهل علينا نطلع أكتر عناصر اتكررت بـmost_common 3
sentences.en: And Counter makes it easy to pull the most repeated elements with most_common(3).

sentences.ar: آخر كروت في القسم ده للمجموعات المتقدمة
sentences.en: The last cards in this section are for advanced collections.

sentences.ar: لو عايزين نعمل queue أو طابور بلاش نستخدم قائمة عادية الأفضل دايماً نستخدم deque
sentences.en: If we want a queue, don't use a plain list; it's always better to use deque.

sentences.ar: لأن السحب والإضافة من الطرفين بياخد خطوة واحدة أو 1 باستخدام popleft وده أسرع بكتير
sentences.en: Because popping and adding at both ends takes a single step (1) with popleft, which is much faster.

sentences.ar: ولو محتاجين دايماً نسحب أصغر قيمة أولاً الـheapq أو طابور الأولوية هو اللي هينقذنا
sentences.en: And if we always need to pull the smallest value first, heapq, the priority queue, is what saves us.

sentences.ar: أما لو عايزين نعمل stack للإضافة والسحبة من الآخر بس فاللستة العادية هتقوم بالواجب والزيادة
sentences.en: But if we just want a stack, adding and removing from the end only, a plain list does the job and more.

sentences.ar: عشان نحفظ البيانات عندنا طريقتين هما الأشهر
sentences.en: To save data we have two ways that are the most popular.

sentences.ar: الـCSV وده ببساطة صفوف وأعمدة مسطحة بسيط وموجود في كل حتة زي جداول الإكسل
sentences.en: CSV is simply flat rows and columns, simple and found everywhere, like Excel sheets.

sentences.ar: الثاني هو الـJSON واللي بيتميز إنه بيسمح ببيانات متداخلة أو nested
sentences.en: The second is JSON, which stands out by allowing nested data.

sentences.ar: يعني ممكن أمر الشرى يكون جواه تفاصيل منتجات كتير
sentences.en: For example, a purchase order can contain details of many products inside it.

sentences.ar: بس الأهم من اختيار النوع هو إننا دايماً نستخدم جملة with open وإحنا بنقرأ أو بنكتب أي ملف
sentences.en: But more important than choosing the format is that we always use the with open statement when reading or writing any file.

sentences.ar: ليه؟ لأنها بتضمن إن الملف يتقفل صح ونتجنب تسريب الذاكرة حتى لو حصل error في النص
sentences.en: Why? Because it guarantees the file gets closed properly and we avoid leaking memory even if an error happens midway.

sentences.ar: البيئة الافتراضية أو الـvirtual environment دي أهم خطوة عشان نعزل مكتبات المشروع ده عن أي مشروع تاني على الجهاز
sentences.en: A virtual environment is the most important step to isolate this project's libraries from any other project on the machine.

sentences.ar: الخطوات بسيطة جداً بننشئ البيئة بـpython -m venv .venv وبنفعلها بـactivate
sentences.en: The steps are very simple: we create the environment with python -m venv .venv and activate it with activate.

sentences.ar: من غير الملف ده لو نقلنا الكود لجهاز تاني ممكن يطلع ModuleNotFoundError والدنيا تقف خالص
sentences.en: Without this file, if we move the code to another machine, a ModuleNotFoundError can show up and everything grinds to a halt.

sentences.ar: تطبيقاً على كل اللي شرحناه دي مخرجات حقيقية لمشروع صغير عملناه اسمه ShopFlow.cli
sentences.en: Applying everything we explained, these are real outputs of a small project we built called ShopFlow.cli.

sentences.ar: قسمنا الشغل الملفات واضحة جداً سكريبت بيحسب الإيرادات revenue.py ومدقق للطلبات validate.py وفهرس للعملاء باستخدام قاموس index.py
sentences.en: We split the work into very clear files: a script that computes revenue, revenue.py; an order validator, validate.py; and a customer index using a dictionary, index.py.

sentences.ar: وعندنا كمان الدالة اللي اسمها order_total بقت منظمة وجاهزة تماما عشان نعملها اختبارات في المرحلة الجاية
sentences.en: And we also have the function called order_total, now organized and fully ready for us to write tests for it in the next stage.

sentences.ar: وفي النهاية الدرس الأهم من الرحلة دي كلها اتقنوا مسار التنفيذ وافهموا اللي بيحصل تحت الغطاء قبل ما تنبهروا بحيل الـsyntax وكتابة الكود السريعة
sentences.en: In the end, the most important lesson of this whole journey: master the execution path and understand what happens under the hood before being dazzled by syntax tricks and writing code fast.

sentences.ar: بناء نموذج ذهني قوي هو اللي هيخليكوا تكتبوا كود أسرع وأنظف وخالي من الأخطاء
sentences.en: Building a strong mental model is what will make you write faster, cleaner, bug-free code.

sentences.ar: يا ترى بقى إيه أكتر مفهوم أو concept حسيتوا أنه غير نظرتكم لطريقة شغل Python وهطبقوا فورا في مشروعكم الجاي
sentences.en: So which concept do you feel changed your view of how Python works the most, and that you'll apply right away in your next project?

sentences.ar: شكرا جدا لوقتكم وشوفكم في الشرح الجاي
sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time, and see you in the next explainer.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: An ordered, changeable Python collection that allows duplicates and index access; checkin…
concepts.failure: Using list membership checks on large data, where a set or dict is far faster.

concepts.def_en: A construct that repeats a block of code for each item or until a condition changes.
concepts.failure: Off-by-one bounds, or a condition that never changes, looping forever.

concepts.def_en: A fixed, ordered Python record that cannot change after creation, so it can serve as a di…
concepts.failure: Forgetting the trailing comma, so a one-element tuple is just the bare value.

concepts.def_en: A Python collection mapping unique keys to values, giving near-instant O(1) lookup by key.
concepts.failure: Indexing a missing key directly and getting KeyError instead of using get.

concepts.def_en: A first-in, first-out collection: items are added at the back and removed from the front.
concepts.failure: Confusing FIFO queues with LIFO stacks, which changes the traversal order entirely.

concepts.def_en: A double-ended queue: items can be added or removed at both ends in one step, so it suits queue use better than a list.
concepts.def_ar: طابور بنهايتين: ممكن نضيف ونشيل من الطرفين بخطوة واحدة، فمناسب للـqueues أكتر من الـlist العادية.
concepts.failure: Using a plain list as a queue, so popping from the front costs linear time.

concepts.def_en: Last-in, first-out structure; in memory, the call stack where function frames are pushed…
concepts.failure: Mixing up stack and heap, or recursing too deeply until the stack overflows.

concepts.def_en: Comma-separated values: a plain-text format of flat rows and columns, simple and universa…
concepts.failure: Assuming CSV preserves data types, so IDs lose leading zeros and dates become text.

concepts.def_en: A text format for nested key-value and list data, the common language of APIs.
concepts.failure: Assuming JSON keeps Python types like tuples or dates after a round trip.

concepts.def_en: A message or failure signalling that something went wrong; read it first, since it usuall…
concepts.failure: Pasting the error into a search engine without first reading the terminal output.

concepts.def_en: A readable, general-purpose programming language widely used for data analysis, automatio…
concepts.failure: Using plain loops over huge data instead of vectorized pandas or SQL operations.

concepts.def_en: A separate sorted lookup structure on one or more columns that lets a database find rows…
concepts.failure: Adding an index on every column; each one slows writes and may never be used.

concepts.def_en: A named, reusable block of code that takes inputs, does a calculation and returns a value.
concepts.failure: Forgetting return, so the function silently gives back None.

concepts.def_en: An automated check that runs code and asserts the expected result, so changes that break…
concepts.failure: Tests that never fail prove nothing; first watch the test fail, then fix.
